# Holostaff AI

> Holostaff AI puts in-product customer success on autopilot. AI staff live inside your
> product. They know it from your code, spot each user the moment they struggle, and step
> in right there in the session. Shipped to your app with one pull request.

Website: https://www.holostaff.ai/
Docs: https://docs.holostaff.ai/
CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@holostaff/cli
Contact: hello@holostaff.ai

## What Holostaff is

Holostaff gives every user of a software product a personal success manager. These are
AI staff members that work inside the product itself, not in a separate chat window or
an email sequence. They learn the product by reading its codebase, watch each user's
session for signs of struggle, and intervene at the moment it matters: guiding, doing
the step together with the user, or fixing the blocker directly on screen.

It is not a chatbot (a chatbot waits to be asked). It is not a product tour (tours are
pre-recorded and the same for everyone). It is not a customer-success back office tool
(those produce health scores and emails after the fact). Holostaff acts inside the
product, during the session, one user at a time.

## How it works

1. Scan. Run `npx @holostaff/cli` in your repo. An agent reads the code and learns the
   product the way an engineer would.
2. Map. It draws every user journey on a canvas and flags where users stall, get
   confused, or drop off.
3. Hire. Turn its proposals into staff. Each one gets a face, a voice, and a job:
   onboarding, activation, retention, expansion.
4. Rehearse. Before any real user sees them, staff face simulated users. AI visitors run
   the real scenarios and every reply is graded on a coverage board.
5. Ship. `holostaff deploy` opens a pull request. Engineers review it like any change.
   One line in the app puts staff on duty.
6. Measure. A built-in impact dashboard shows lift on activation, retention, and
   expansion, plus every intervention as it happens.

## Key facts

- Setup: one CLI scan; no instrumentation, no data migration.
- Works with any web stack; staff run from one script tag plus the SDK.
- Control: every staff member is approved by the customer, rehearsed against simulated
  users, shipped through normal PR review, logged, and revocable.
- Pricing: free to start, no credit card; usage billed on engagement.
- Category: in-product customer success, AI success manager, user activation and
  onboarding software.
